content.json:
# Storage Operational Workbook

Auto-generated from resource discovery. Source: `{{sourceSubscriptions}}` — inventory `{{inventoryTimestamp}}`.

Covers Storage Accounts, Managed Disks, SQL, and Cosmos DB.

---

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.storage/storageaccounts','microsoft.compute/disks','microsoft.sql/servers/databases','microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts')
| summarize Count = count() by type, location
| order by Count desc
content.title: Storage resources by type and region

content.query:
StorageBlobLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Transactions = count(), Errors = countif(toint(StatusCode) >= 400) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| extend ErrorRate = round(100.0 * Errors / Transactions, 2)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Blob transactions and error rate

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.STORAGE'
| where MetricName == 'UsedCapacity'
| summarize UsedBytes = max(Maximum) by Resource
| extend UsedGB = round(UsedBytes / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2)
| project Resource, UsedGB
| order by UsedGB desc
content.title: Used capacity by storage account (GB)
